title: ORR Submission Planning
text: Project manager schedules ORR artifact submission 45 calendar days before the planned go-live date.

title: IV&V Reporting Cadence
text: Request an IV&V progress report from the vendor every 60 days and file it in the project repository.

title: Artifact Retention
text: Keep certification artifacts for 6 years and store them in the records system.

title: Program Integrity Checklist Prep
text: Complete the program integrity checklist covering claims edits and provider screening before the ORR.
